site.title: Kerala crop prices
site.tagline: Daily mandi prices and the price expected in 7 days for banana, coconut, pepper, rubber and tapioca.

prices.stale: Stale: no new price for more than 3 days
prices.history: Last 90 days and the expected range
prices.subscribe: Get the daily update on Telegram
prices.note: A range, not a guarantee. Source: Agmarknet modal prices (₹/quintal ÷ 100).

accuracy.title: How accurate is it?
accuracy.intro: Live error of the published forecast (rolling 28 days) against the simplest forecast: the price in a week = today's price ("naive").
accuracy.coverage: How often the price fell inside the range
accuracy.whyTitle: Why is the published forecast the naive one?
accuracy.why: We tested a machine-learning model (LightGBM) with many signals: arrivals, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka market prices, weather and festivals. Over two years of back-tests none beat "last price" for the price level, so we publish the honest naive forecast and use the model only for the uncertainty range.
accuracy.noData: Live accuracy appears once forecasts mature (7+ days).

models.title: Models and decisions
models.intro: Every promotion decision is logged with its evidence. A challenger replaces the champion only if it beats it by at least 3 % with statistical significance (p < 0.05).

challenger.title: The shadow challenger
challenger.intro: A classifier predicts whether a price will rise or fall by more than 3 % in 7 days. It runs in shadow (never shown to users) and is judged only on new data, by rules fixed in advance.
challenger.c1: At least 12 weeks of shadow data and 30 real moves per crop
challenger.c2: Beats both "always flat" and "trend continues" (balanced Diebold–Mariano test, Holm-corrected, p < 0.05)
challenger.c3: Up and down calls each right at least 55 % of the time and 10 points above the base rate

drift.title: Data drift
drift.intro: Every Sunday the last 14 days are compared with the 90 days before (Evidently). Only relative inputs are checked (price changes, volatility, spread); price levels, calendar and weather change with the season by design. Input drift is informational. Alerts come only from accuracy: live error above 1.5× the back-test for 7 days, range coverage outside 70–90 %, or a significant shift in weekly price changes (p < 0.01).
drift.share: Share of relative inputs that drifted (informational)
drift.flag: Flagged: half or more of the inputs drifted. Informational only.
